evidence_slice: Bristol City Council's Site Allocations dataset is the adopted Site Allocations and Development Management Policies Local Plan (July 2014), including Policy SA1 site allocations. Council material identifies Hengrove Park as Site Allocation BSA1401, for housing, offices and open space including a large high-quality park, with an estimated 1,000 homes. The Bristol DATAGOV catalogue lists Site allocations and publishes GIS access including GeoJSON/WFS resources. The available web transport did not return the raw GeoJSON bytes in this session, so no polygon coordinates are fabricated; the exact official allocation identifier BSA1401 is retained for local OpenCode boundary resolution.
